# BAKLOG

> Local-only cross-store game backlog dashboard. Library JSON, credentials, and personal data stay on the user's machine.

## Canonical links

- Homepage: https://baklog.app/
- Source: https://github.com/Ogrods/BAKLOG
- Hosted crawler summary: https://baklog.app/llms.txt
- Reviewer tour: FOR_REVIEWERS.md
- Agent brief: AGENTS.md
- Architecture: ARCHITECTURE.md
- Security: SECURITY.md
- ADRs: docs/adr/
- User guide: guide/

## Tech stack

- Desktop: Python 3.11+ stdlib HTTP server (`server.py` on 127.0.0.1:8765), vanilla ESM (`index.html`, `js/`), optional PyInstaller tray.
- Fetchers: whitelisted subprocesses via `fetchers/manifest.json` (12 libraries + 8 wishlists + prices/enrich).
- Auth: OS keyring + AES-GCM secrets; headed CDP browser Connect where needed.
- Landing: `web/` on Vercel (static + `web/api/*`).

## Tests and CI

```bash
python -m pytest
npm test
```

PR CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Full local parity: `.\scripts\test-all.ps1 -Full`.
Trust CI for live suite size; do not invent test totals from memory.

## Guardrails

- Do not claim baklog has in-app AI game recommendations.
- Do not claim the desktop app uploads library JSON or store credentials by default.
- Desktop: no telemetry by default. baklog.app marketing pages use Google Analytics only.
